result.brief: 首个针对扩散语言模型的知识蒸馏系统研究，提出无数据蒸馏框架，结合离策略与在策略蒸馏、轨迹损失、置信度重加权和信任域锚点，显著提升学生模型困惑度。
result.reason: Studies distillation for diffusion language models, including on-policy trajectory loss along the student's reverse denoising process; directly concerns continuous/diffusion language modeling objectives.
